esa: [ eta + si-vibhata.] (pu) CL=7 [(In thī) esa (saṃ)] This is. That is.
[ isa + ṇa.] (ti) CL=7 [Esa + a. esa (saṃ)] One who seeks or acquires.
[ ima(idaṃ) + naṃ-vibhata.]  CL=9 Ima (idaṃ) is changed to e. The case-ending -naṃ is changed to saṃ.] to them, of them.
esaka: [ (isa)esa + ṇvu ] (ti) CL=7 One who seeks or one who causes to complete.
esamāna: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + a + māna ] (ti) CL=7 One who is a seeker or one who seeks (for).
esana: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + yu ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who seeks. (2) Should be sought.
esanabahula: [ esanā + bahula ] (ti) CL=7 One who seeks frequently.
esanabhāvarasa: [(esana+bhāva=) esanabhāva + rasa ] (ti) CL=7 The function that is a state of seeking.
esanasīla: [ esanā + sīla ] (ti) CL=7 One who used to seek.
esanataṇhā: [ esanā + taṇhā ] (thī) CL=7 Taṇhā that arises by the power of seeking.
esanaṭṭha: [(jasana) esanā + attha ] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of a state of acquiring. The meaning of acquirement.
esanisalākā: [ esanī + salākā ] (thī) CL=7 A stick that is stirring (in something) to find a spike. See below.
esantha: [(1) isa(isi,esa,esu) + anta. (2) isa(isu)+anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who seeks. (2) One who longs for.
esanthi: [ isa (isi,esa,esu) + a + anthi ] (kri) CL=7 They seek. See - Esati 1 (1).
[ isa(isu) + a + anti ] (kri) CL=7 They want. They long for. See - Esati 2.
esanā: [ (1) isa(isi,esa,esu) + yu + ā (itthīpaccaññaḥ.) (2) isa (isu) + yu + ā. ] (thī) CL=7 [Esanā (saṃ)] (1) (A) Seeking. (seeking sensual pleasure, seeking requisites such as alms). (B) Investigates or concentrates and contemplates. (C) Livelihood. (2) (Dhamma) that is a cause of seeking). (Dhamma) that should be sought. (4) Longing for or desirable.
esanābhāvanā: [ esanā + bhāvanā ] (thī) CL=7 Bhāvanā that is a cause of seeking. (Bhāvanā that is a cause of seeking appanā).
esanāhetu: [ esanā + hetu ] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is seeking (for).
esanākāla: [ esanā + kāla ] (pu) CL=7 A period of seeking and investigating.
esanāniddesa: [ esanā + niddesa ] (pu) CL=7 A section that is an analytical description of esanā.
esanāpasuta: [ esanā + pasuta ] (ti) CL=7 One who is engaged in seeking.
esanāsuñña: [ esanā + suñña ] (thī,na) CL=7 (1) The dhamma that is the cessation of seeking nekkhamma (such as kāmacchanda). (2) The dhamma that causes the cessation of seeking (nekkhamma, etc.,) that is (kāmacchanda, etc.,).
esanāvagga: [ esanā + vagga ] (pu) CL=7 Esanāvagga. A set of (11) suttas such as esanā sutta.
esanī: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + yu + ī (itthī paccaññaḥ.] (thī) CL=7 A stick that is for stirring (in something) to find a spike.
esanīya: [(1) isa(isi,esa,esu) + anīya. (2) isa(isu)+anīya]  CL=9 (1) that should be sought. (2) that should be longed for.
esati: [ isa (isi,esa,esu) + a + ti.] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.173,181,188,189,190. Dhātvattha. 23,35. Esati (saṃ)] (1) He seeks. (2) He always follows. (3) He crosses over. (4) He investigates. (5) He insights.
[ isa (isa) + a + ti.] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 190. Dhātvattha. 23,24. Esati (saṃ)] He wants. He longs for.
esatu: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + a + tu ] (kri) CL=7 May he seek. See - Esati 1 (1).
esaṃ: [ ima(idaṃ) + naṃ-vibhata.]  CL=9 Ima (idaṃ) is changed to e. The case-ending -naṃ is changed to saṃ.] to them, of them.
ese: [ eta + si (vibhata)] (pu) CL=7 This is. That is.
esese: [ (ka) ese ese' hupudaphratamū 'eta+si. Eta+si' tiu့phraṅa့prīḥso nāmavibhatachuṃḥso puda(2)khu phracasañña. (kha) 'ese se' tiu့phraṅa့prīḥso nāmavibhata chuṃḥso pudanhacakhuphracasañña.'] (pu) CL=7 (A) Ese=eso. This is. Ese=eso. Only this is. (B) Ese=‌eso. This is. Se=so. Only that is.
eseyya: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + eyya ] (kri) CL=7 He should seek. See - Esati 1 (4).
esi: [ i + a + si.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + a + si.] You come. See - Eti (5).
[ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ī ] (kri) CL=7 He sought. See - Esati 1 (1).
[ isa(isi,esa,esu) + iṃ ] (kri) CL=7 One who investigates and insights. See - Esati (5).
esikatthambhaesikāthambha: [ esikā + thambha ] (pu) CL=7 (1) A gate pillar. (2) (Faith, etc.,) that is like a gate pillar or that is as firm as a gate pillar.
esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhita: [ esikaṭṭhāyī + ṭhita ] (ti) CL=7 Standing firm as a pillar of a gate or door.
esikaṭṭhāyī: [ esikā + ṭṭhāyī ] (ti) CL=7 A gate pillar that is standing firm. See - esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhita.
esikā: [ esa + ika.] (thī,na) CL=7 [Isu+ika. Dhāna,ṭī.204. Esīka (saṃ)] (1) A gate pillar. (Taṇhā, faith) that is like a gate pillar. (3) A country is named Esikā.
esikānāmaka: [ esikā + nāma + ka ] (ti) CL=7 One who is named Esikā.
esikāraṭṭha: [ esikā + raṭṭha ] (na) CL=7  A country is named Esikā. See - Esikā(3).
esissaṃ: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ssaṃ ]  CL=9 (I) will seek. See  esati 1 (1).
esissāmi: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ssāmi ] (kri) CL=7 I will seek. See - Esati 1 (1).
esita: [ isa(isi,esa,esu)+ta ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who seeks. (2) (A) Should be sought. (B) Sought and obtained.
esitabba: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + tabba ] (ti) CL=7 Should be sent (someone).
[ isa(isu) + tabba ] (ti) CL=7 Should be desired or longed.
esitaguṇa: [ esita + guṇa ] (ti) CL=7 One who has the quality that is sought.
esitataṇhā: [ esitā + taṇhā ] (ti) CL=7 Taṇhā that arise on the wealth that is sought.
esitu: [ isa(isi,esa+esu) + tu ] (thī,pu) CL=7 One who seeks or one who is a seeker.
esiyamāna: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ya + māna ] (ti) CL=7 (One) who is seeking. See below.
esiyamānaguṇa: [ esiyamāna + guṇa ] (ti) CL=7 One who has the quality that is seeking. See - Esita-guṇa (B).
esiṃ: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + iṃ ] (kri) CL=7 One who investigates and insights. See - Esati (5).
essanthi: [ i + ssanti ] (kri) CL=7 He will arrive. See - Eti (1).
essasi: [ i + ssasi.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā+i+ssāsi ] You will come. See - Eti (4).
essati: [ i + ssati.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + ssati. ] (1) He will arrive. See - Eti (1). (2) He will come. See - Eti (4). (3) He will approach. See - Eti(6). (4) He will follow forever. See - Eti (7).
essaṃ: [ i + ssaṃ.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + ssaṃ] I will come. See - Eti (4).
essāmi: [ i+ssāmi.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā+i+ssāmi] I will come. See - Eti (4).
esu: [ ima (idaṃ) + su-vibhata.] (ti) CL=7 In this. See - Esaṃ.
esukārī: [ yādicchakanāma ] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Esukārī. (1) A king is named Esukārī, (2) A brahmin is named Esukārī.
esukārīrāja: [ esukārī + rāja ] (pu) CL=7 A king is named Esukārī.
esāmi: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + a + mi ] (kri) CL=7 I will seek. See - Esati 1 (1).
esāna: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + a + māna.] (ti) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.399. Moga,5. 162.] One who is seeking (for).
esī: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ṇī ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is seeking. (2) One who crosses (over). (One who desires to cross over. Jāta,sya.) (3) One who is living or dwelling.
[ isa(isu) + ṇī ] (ti) CL=7 One who wants or desires.
esīyanthi: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ya + ante ] (kamma,kri) CL=7 They should seek (for).
esissa: [ isa(isi,esa,esu) + ssaṃ ]  CL=9 (I) will seek. See  esati 1 (1).
essa: [ i + ssaṃ.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + ssaṃ] I will come. See - Eti (4).
